summary: Event put on an entity by the per-frame update of esv::party::PartySystem (bg3.exe+0x2BB7AD0 -> 0x2BC35A0): the system's own pending map at PartySystem+0x140 is copied into the new component and then cleared. Script Extender names that system member PostReloadStorySetup (Party.h: HashMap<EntityHandle, glm::vec3>). No savegame model, not replicated.

fields.name: PostReloadStorySetup
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2BC54E0 allocates 0x40 and zeroes three Array headers at +0/+0x10/+0x20 (HashSet) and one at +0x30; destructor bg3.exe+0x5C4870 frees the value array at +0x30 without element destructor, then FUN_140582ad0 (POD HashSet destructor: frees +0x20, +0x10, +0). bg3.exe+0x2BC3850 copies PartySystem+0x140 into it: HashSet copy, then values copied with stride 12 (8 + 4 bytes) = glm::vec3. Key width 8 not read directly; EntityHandle per Script Extender's PartySystem::PostReloadStorySetup (HashMap<EntityHandle, glm::vec3>), which is the map copied here. Second pass: the copy bg3.exe+0x2BC3850 (called by bg3.exe+0x2BC35A0 right after the creator, source PartySystem+0x140) copies the key set with FUN_141008810, whose key array copy FUN_1410092E0 moves 8-byte keys, then the values at +0x30 as 12-byte elements (one 8-byte and one 4-byte move per element, stride 0xC) - EntityHandle keys and glm::vec3 values.

open_questions: Key type EntityHandle (8 bytes, plain copy) and value glm::vec3 (12 bytes) are established by width on Windows; the names follow Script Extender's PartySystem::PostReloadStorySetup.
second_pass: Widths settled on Windows: bg3.exe+0x2BC3850 copies 8-byte keys (FUN_141008810 / FUN_1410092E0) and 12-byte values into the 64-byte map, matching SE's HashMap<EntityHandle, glm::vec3> PostReloadStorySetup.
